question: What does Securitize actually run, and which of its companies holds which license?
answer: Securitize runs the official ownership record for tokenized funds and stocks, not the money. Through 6 separate companies it acts as an SEC-registered transfer agent, a broker-dealer with a trading system, an investment adviser, a fund administrator and an EU trading-and-settlement operator; each license belongs to that one subsidiary, not to the listed parent.

sections.title: How a Securitize product works, start to finish
rows: 1 · Create and appoint

rows.text: The issuer or fund creates the security under governing documents and appoints the exact service entities.
rows.note: Securitize technology cannot create the legal claim without the issuer and governing instrument.

rows: Issuer / fund sponsor
Charter, offering document, board authorization and service agreements
2 · Admit the investor and wallet

rows.text: Identity, eligibility, sanctions and wallet checks bind a legal person to an approved account or wallet.
rows.note: A public wallet address alone is not a verified shareholder identity or permission to hold every product.

rows: Transfer agent, broker-dealer and product compliance functions
Off-chain identity file, account approval and wallet whitelist
3 · Subscribe and fund

rows.text: The investor submits an order and supplies the permitted cash or stablecoin consideration.
rows.note: Stablecoin conversion is a funding interface; it does not itself issue the fund share or discharge every cash obligation.

rows: Broker/dealer or platform plus the fund's cash and custody providers
Subscription acceptance, cash receipt and fund books
4 · Issue and record

rows.text: The transfer agent records the owner and causes the permitted token representation to be minted or credited.
rows.note: There is no universal Securitize record model; the governing documents for the particular security decide what is authoritative.

rows: Appointed transfer agent
Product-specific official register: control book, composite blockchain-plus-identity register, or linked incumbent register
5 · Transfer or trade

rows.text: A whitelisted peer transfer or eligible venue trade changes the token position and must remain synchronized with the legal record.
rows.note: Network confirmation does not substitute for investor eligibility, venue obligations or transfer-agent correction authority.

rows: Transfer agent for permitted transfer; broker-dealer/ATS for venue execution; network for technical ordering
Transfer-agent record plus network transaction and, where relevant, broker/ATS books
6 · Service and correct

rows.text: Dividends, distributions, freezes, clawbacks, burns, reissues and corporate actions are applied through the appointed legal and technical controls.
rows.note: Immutable transaction history can remain while a later instruction establishes the legally corrected current state.

rows: Issuer, transfer agent, administrator and other appointed providers
Current shareholder register plus corporate-action and servicing records
7 · Redeem and pay

rows.text: The holder submits a valid redemption; the share is cancelled or burned and the fund or its providers deliver the allowed payout.
rows.note: The transfer agent can process a legal redemption off-chain during a network outage, but it does not become the bank, reserve custodian or stablecoin issuer.

rows: Fund/issuer, transfer agent, custodian and cash provider
Redemption acceptance, cancelled share balance and bank or stablecoin payout evidence

items.title: BUIDL · transfer-agent control book across several chains
kv: Securitize's appointed transfer-agent record governs serviced fund shares while supported blockchain share classes and Wormhole carry bounded technical representations and movements.
BlackRock/fund issuer and manager; BNY and other appointed providers; named networks; optional USDC or RLUSD conversion providers.
Multichain does not mean seven independent legal supplies. The control book and mint/burn discipline keep outstanding units singular across representations.

items.title: BRSRV / RSVXX · blockchain records plus off-chain identity form the official register
kv: The prospectus says blockchain balances together with the transfer agent's off-chain wallet-to-identity register constitute the official shareholder register and conclusively govern record ownership absent technical failure.

BlackRock Funds is the fund; BlackRock Advisors manages it; BlackRock Investments distributes it; BNY is custodian and accounting provider; Securitize Transfer Agent is transfer agent/tokenization provider.

This is the clearest current example of public-chain state entering the official record without making the blockchain, wallet or token the whole legal system. Off-chain redemption continues during a network outage.

items.title: Issuer-sponsored public equity · linked incumbent register
kv: For reviewed public-equity arrangements, the tokenized interest remains connected to the issuer's official shareholder register and corporate actions; an incumbent registrar can remain primary while Securitize acts as a secondary transfer agent for tokenized interests.
The public issuer, primary registrar/transfer agent, exchange or ATS, market makers and settlement/cash providers remain distinct.
Tokenization can be an attached record layer rather than a replacement for DTC, the primary registrar or the issuer's legal books.

sections.title: Ripple and Securitize: two different control planes
sections.sub: Ripple organizes the movement, custody, liquidity and enterprise management of money and digital assets. Securitize organizes the creation, ownership, transfer, servicing and correction of regulated securities. Their strongest fit is not duplication but a title-side and cash-side interface.
rows: Organizing object
Money and asset movement: collect, hold, exchange, pay, custody, finance and manage liquidity.
The security: constitute the claim, identify the holder, maintain the official record, enforce transfer rules and service the instrument.
Ripple is route-centered; Securitize is instrument-and-title-centered.
Issued claim
Standard Custody issues RLUSD. XRP is a separate native network asset, not a Ripple corporate liability. Ripple generally does not create the legal fund or public-equity claim.
The outside issuer or fund creates the security; Securitize records and services it when appointed. Securitize has no universal house stablecoin or money claim.
Ripple owns a money-issuance seat; Securitize usually owns a service-and-record seat around someone else's security.
Authoritative record
No single Ripple book governs every product. Payment, custody, prime, treasury, RLUSD-issuer and XRPL records remain distinct; XRPL consensus does not by itself determine off-chain legal title.
The appointed transfer agent can maintain the controlling shareholder record: an off-chain control book, a blockchain-plus-identity composite register or a layer linked to an incumbent registrar.
This is Securitize's strongest unique seat and Ripple's clearest gap.
Payments and distribution
Ripple Payments owns collect-hold-exchange-payout orchestration across stablecoins, crypto and local currencies, with product availability varying by entity and jurisdiction.
Distributes and services eligible securities and can expose stablecoin funding or redemption interfaces, but does not operate a general cross-border payout network.
Ripple carries value to or from the instrument; Securitize admits and services the investor in the instrument.
Custody and keys
Ripple Custody supplies institutional key-policy, MPC/HSM and wallet-orchestration technology; exact safekeeping duties depend on deployment and legal entity.
Securitize Markets reports expanded tokenized-security custody capability, while fund portfolio custody and cash custody can remain with outside bodies such as BNY.
Ripple is broader digital-asset custody infrastructure; Securitize custody is narrower and attached to its regulated securities perimeter.
Markets and liquidity
Ripple Prime spans multi-asset clearing, financing, margin and execution across digital assets and traditional markets.
Securitize Markets supplies placement and ATS trading for eligible tokenized securities and reports underwriting and selling-group expansion.
Ripple is the broader liquidity-and-financing machine; Securitize is the regulated issuance-and-secondary-venue specialist.
Treasury and administration
Ripple Treasury is an enterprise treasury-management system joining bank, custody, fiat and digital-asset data and workflows.
Securitize Fund Services provides fund administration, NAV and investor reporting; it is not a general corporate TMS.
Ripple serves the corporate treasurer; Securitize serves the fund and security-administration stack.
Network and ledger
Ripple is a major builder and ecosystem participant around XRPL, but the public network is separately governed and Ripple Payments is not limited to one asset or rail.

Securitize is deliberately multichain; public networks carry representations while product documents and appointed recordkeepers decide title. Its EU TSS is a separate regulated venue-and-settlement body.
Ripple has a strategic home ledger without owning it; Securitize treats chains as substitutable execution and record components beneath product law.
Regulated body
The group includes payments licenses, Standard Custody and a preliminary, unopened national trust-bank charter; licenses remain entity- and jurisdiction-specific.
The group includes a registered transfer agent, broker-dealer/ATS, investment adviser, fund administrator and EU DLT TSS operator, but not the fund's bank or universal cash-settlement body.
Ripple's regulatory perimeter is money, custody and market infrastructure; Securitize's is security issuance, recordkeeping, advice, administration and venue access.
Correction and remedy

Product contracts, issuer records, custody controls, market books and payment rails determine reversal, asset return and cash remedy. Ripple cannot correct an outside fund's shareholder register merely by moving RLUSD or recording an XRPL transaction.

When appointed, the transfer agent can freeze, claw back, burn, reissue and correct the current shareholder record; it cannot by that authority compel a bank payout or rewrite an outside stablecoin issuer's liability.
Ripple repairs the money, custody or market leg under the relevant product; Securitize repairs the security-title leg under the governing instrument.

sections.title: Where Ripple and Securitize fit into the GENIUS Act
sections.sub: Enacted statute; core implementation remains proposed at this cutoff
rows: Which object is inside GENIUS?

RLUSD fits the payment-stablecoin definition because it is designed for payment or settlement and carries a fixed-dollar redemption obligation. XRP does not fit that definition merely because it can move value: it has no issuer obligation to redeem at a fixed monetary value.

BUIDL, VBILL, BRSRV/RSVXX and tokenized public-equity interests remain securities. The Act's definition excludes securities from payment stablecoins, even when the security has a dollar NAV or can be exchanged into a stablecoin.
Who must pass the issuer gate?

Standard Custody & Trust Company is the disclosed RLUSD issuer and current NYDFS-chartered obligor. To issue under the federal regime it must fit an approved state-qualified or federal-qualified route. Ripple's brand, software licenses and preliminary national trust-bank approval do not substitute for approval of the exact issuing entity.

Securitize is generally transfer agent, broker-dealer/ATS, adviser, administrator or technology provider around securities issued by outside funds and companies. It does not become the RLUSD issuer by offering the exchange interface.
What backs the cash leg?

A permitted issuer must maintain identifiable reserves at least one-for-one in the statutory categories and meet redemption, disclosure, custody and supervisory requirements. RLUSD's disclosed short-duration reserve design is directionally aligned, but regulator approval and exact final-rule conformance remain separate findings.

A tokenized Treasury or fund share is not automatically an eligible RLUSD reserve asset. The statute can admit a registered government money-market fund invested solely in eligible assets and tokenized versions of permitted reserves, but actual eligibility depends on the exact product, portfolio, legal ownership and regulator treatment.
Where can yield sit?
GENIUS bars a permitted or qualifying foreign issuer from paying interest or yield solely for holding, using or retaining the payment stablecoin.

A separately constituted fund share can carry investment return because it is a security rather than the payment stablecoin. Exchanging RLUSD for a security, or a security for RLUSD, preserves two instruments and two claims.
Who can freeze or correct what?

The stablecoin issuer must have the technical capability to comply with lawful orders that can require seizure, freezing, burning or prevention of transfer of identified payment stablecoins or accounts. BSA, sanctions, customer-identification and due-diligence duties also attach to the issuer framework.

An appointed transfer agent can freeze, claw back, burn, reissue or correct the security-side shareholder record under the governing instrument. That authority does not let it rewrite Standard Custody's stablecoin liability.
How do the operating companies enter?

Ripple Payments, Custody, Prime, Treasury or distribution entities can enter the analysis when an exact entity exchanges, transfers, safeguards, offers or sells a payment stablecoin for compensation. Their other products are not converted into stablecoin issuance merely because RLUSD is available inside the stack.

Securitize Markets or another exact affiliate can enter as a digital-asset service provider on the stablecoin funding, exchange, settlement or custody leg. The securities placement, ATS, transfer-agency and fund-administration legs retain their separate legal bases.
What happens if one side fails?
GENIUS creates reserve-asset and bankruptcy priorities for payment-stablecoin holders and distinguishes the issuer's redemption obligation from a wallet balance or market price.

The investor's rights in the fund or equity security continue to depend on the issuer, governing documents and controlling shareholder record. A corrected share register does not itself produce dollars; a successful stablecoin redemption does not itself restore the share.

uncertain: Group consolidation does not merge the licenses, appointments or duties of the named subsidiaries. A token can be part of an official shareholder register in one product, a representation reconciled to a transfer-agent control book in another, or a secondary layer attached to an incumbent registrar in a third.

catalog_context.title: Who actually controls the crypto infrastructure
catalog_context.answer: Of 20 crypto networks and companies we track, only one is used at scale and none is proven under stress; many brands rest on a handful of legal providers.

catalog_context.title: Which companies connect the new private money system
catalog_context.answer: No single coin or blockchain is taking over. Banks, crypto firms, card networks and market utilities each control a different step, and the most powerful firms may be the ones connecting those separate systems.
